meta.title: Proxy manager
meta.description: Sets, inspects and clears the proxy configuration of 13 developer tools — Git, npm, pnpm, Yarn, Cargo, pip, Maven, Gradle, DeepSeek Harness, Docker, the shell environment, curl and wget — from Settings → Proxy. One switch per tool, Enable/Clear for all, use the system proxy, and open any configuration file; you can add your own tools from the same page. Running programs keep the proxy they read at start-up, so restart them after a change.
